answer: Repeating an already-covered mechanism thus earns nothing extra, so one template cannot pay for 63 aliases however many keys the operator holds. Because the prism reference is updated at each dune checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the copper audit records how much each answer added. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 7 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
